fact: At a workshop held from 29 July to 2 August 2024 the MENRS stated that, through the Twige Neza programme with the Global Partnership for Education and the Agence Française de Développement, it is to be given a human resources module integrated into the central SIGE and compatible with the STATEDUC application, under an agreement signed with UNESCO in December 2022 for a 35-month project ending on 14 February 2026; the module covers staff recruitment and deployment, not learners.
title: Atelier d'appropriation et de revue de la planification des activités du projet d'appui à l'opérationnalisation du module de gestion des ressources humaines du SIGE BURUNDI.
publisher: Ministère de l'Education Nationale et de la Recherche Scientifique
